note: Audit 538366-c1/538366-s1: Same article, same medium (water), same variable (fluence) and the same measurement kind (TEM geometric-diameter particle-count mean), but the claim is restricted to the intermediate region 7-35 J/cm2: its evidence is Fig. 3, 14, 13, 13, 12 and 8 nm at 7, 11, 14, 18 and 35 J/cm2 (p.3), while series 538366-s1 spans 4-88 J/cm2 with nine points. The pipeline computes one shape over the whole series, and that shape is irregular because of the 4 J/cm2 point (6.06 nm) and the high-fluence rise (10.99, 11.99 and 13.39 nm at 53, 70 and 88 J/cm2), both outside the claimed range. Scoring the full-range shape against a sub-range claim would substitute an untested range, so the candidate is retained but no agreement judgment on the 7-35 J/cm2 range is defensible.; caveats: Within the claimed range the five series points do fall (14.55, 13.16, 12.89, 12.73 and 7.90 nm), but that is an observation about the points, not the pipeline's shape. The 4 J/cm2 point (6.06 nm) lies below the 7 J/cm2 point (14.55 nm), which is why the full series is irregular rather than a valley; the text's narrative does not cover that low-fluence rise. Histogram means from stored bar centres differ slightly from the text's rounded values (70 J/cm2: 11.99 vs 13 nm; 88 J/cm2: 13.39 vs 14 nm). Stored SDs are available but particle counts are not. Neither enters the fixed tolerances.

Audit 538366-c1/538366-s3: Series 538366-s3 is the focusing-position experiment (above focus 17 J/cm2, below focus 25 J/cm2, at focus 280 J/cm2; 8, 7 and 9 nm), not the fixed-focus fluence series the claim describes. The article states that changing the focusing position 'is not only changing the fluence but also change the degree of ionization of surrounding liquid medium' (p.6), so the fluence variation is confounded with the focusing geometry and the plasma conditions, and only two of the three points (17 and 25 J/cm2) lie inside the claimed 7-35 J/cm2 range. No defensible agreement judgment on the claim's range is possible.; caveats: Three points only, and the shape is flat in both models because the 1 nm steps are inside the fixed 10%/20% tolerances. The pulse duration differs (6 ns here versus 10 ns in the claim's series) and the spot size differs between the three positions (600, 150 and 500 um, p.6-7). The text attributes the size differences of this series to the plasma conditions at the three positions, not to a fluence dependence.
